description: Persistent graph-structured memory for LLMs in TriliumNext Notes — readable and editable by humans.
name: io.github.miisodev/brainllm

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the TriliumNext instance, e.g. http://localhost:8080
environmentVariables.name: TRILIUM_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: ETAPI token. Required unless TRILIUM_PASSWORD is set. Create one in Trilium under Options → ETAPI.
environmentVariables.name: TRILIUM_ETAPI_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Alternative to TRILIUM_ETAPI_TOKEN — BrainLLM mints a token on first start and caches it beside brainllm.json.
environmentVariables.name: TRILIUM_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: core (default) exposes the 39 brain-aware tools; full additionally exposes the 33 raw ETAPI tools.
environmentVariables.name: BRAINLLM_MODE

environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone used to stamp dated notes, e.g. Africa/Johannesburg. Defaults to the host timezone.
environmentVariables.name: BRAINLLM_TZ

environmentVariables.description: Enables the OAuth 2.1 / CIMD endpoints required by claude.ai and other hosted Claude surfaces. This is the password entered on the consent screen when authorizing a client.
environmentVariables.name: BRAINLLM_OWNER_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Override for the public origin when a proxy rewrites Host. Must exactly match the URL entered in the client.
environmentVariables.name: BRAINLLM_PUBLIC_URL
